title: Baked Dark Chocolate Pots de Crème
summary: Silky dark chocolate custards baked gently in a water bath until just set, then chilled.

ingredients.item: dark chocolate (about 70% cocoa solids), finely chopped
ingredients.note: check the label for soya and milk

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: heat the oven to 160 °C (140 °C fan) and set the ramekins in the roasting tin. Boil the kettle. A water bath keeps the heat gentle so the custard stays smooth.

steps.title: Chocolate base
steps.text: bring the milk, cream and salt just to the boil, pour over the chocolate, leave 3 min, then whisk until smooth. Hot liquid melts the chocolate evenly.

steps.title: Yolks
steps.text: whisk the yolks, sugar and vanilla together, then whisk them into the warm chocolate mixture and strain into the jug.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: pour into the ramekins, add hot water to come two-thirds up their sides, cover the tin loosely with foil and bake 35-45 min, until the edges are set, the centres wobble slightly and the centre reads 80 °C. The centre firms further as it cools.

steps.title: Cool and chill
steps.text: lift the ramekins onto the rack for 15 min, then chill at least 4 h. Serve with a little cream if you like. Chilling gives a dense, silky texture.

tips: A common mistake is overbaking, which makes the custard grainy; take it out while the centre still wobbles.
Pour hot water carefully so none splashes into the custards.
Strain the mixture for the smoothest finish.
storage: Cover and keep in the fridge for up to 3 days. Do not freeze.
